members: Rocco Arena 39 (head, b. Sept 1861 Italy, arrived 1892, married 10 years); Genneroso Arena 30 (wife, Italy); Anna Arena 7 (daughter, Italy); Antonio Arena 5 (son, NEW YORK); Lorenzo Costa 24 (Italy); Rocco Arlotta 23 (Italy); Domenico Arena 18 (Italy); John Arena 42 (Italy); Rafael Arena 17 (Italy)
note: THE RICHEST SINGLE RECORD THIS ARCHIVE HAS FOUND. It confirms the tree on four points at once -- Rocco Arena's 1892 arrival, Generosa Costa as his wife, Anna as his daughter, and ANTONIO BORN IN NEW YORK -- and adds two facts the tree does not have: he was MARRIED IN 1890 (ten years married in 1900) and he gave his birth as SEPTEMBER 1861, where act 228 says 20 December 1861. Census birth months are self-reported and three months adrift is ordinary; the YEAR agrees. Ward 6 of Manhattan contains Mulberry Street, which is where the 1899 manifest sent his brother. THE OTHER FIVE NAMES ARE THE FINDING: Lorenzo COSTA (Generosa's surname), Rocco ARLOTTA (Serafina Arlotta's surname), and three more ARENA -- Domenico 18, John 42 and Rafael 17. This is a Scilla chain-migration household under one roof. JOHN ARENA, 42, is almost certainly the brother Giovanni who brought Anna over in 1899, though the census age gives 1858 where the manifest gives 1854. LORENZO COSTA, 24, is almost certainly the Lorenjo Costa, 26, of Scilla who came off the Neustria on 13 March 1901 two lines from a Donato.

head: — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND —
members: Neither Michele Donato nor Giovanni Polistena
note: The Liguria manifest sent both men to QUINCY, FLORIDA in February 1908. The 1910 census for the whole of Gadsden County lists FIFTEEN people born in Italy and neither of them is there. So Quincy was where they were GOING, not where they stayed. That fits what is already known: Giovanni Polistena was back at Scilla to marry Nunziata Donato about 1916, and Michele Donato's wife and household remained at Via Grotte throughout. The 1908 crossing looks like seasonal or short-term labour rather than emigration -- which is a different story from the one the tree implies by recording an arrival and nothing else.
